title: Only one H1 is allowed

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: An H1 with the name of the project or site. This is the only required section.
spec.note: The spec describes exactly one H1; a second H1 is a local structural convention we enforce, not a spec-tested conformance failure -- conformance_testable is false. Recalled from training-data familiarity with the public page, not re-verified against a live fetch this session.

applicability: An llms.txt body that already has a valid H1.

cases.name: a second H1 appears after the first
